notes.title: Big V 1.1.0.0 update
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R91dXx82ro8

Hello, Here is the Update V 1.1.0.0

I was planning to make short and continuous updates, but in this update, I wanted to finish some processes to make the game more stable and better. That's why I worked on this update for 1 year. A total of 230 improvements, bug fixes and updates were made.

I have listed below some of the operations done in this update, I hope you like it. If the game can be successful, I want to come up with a better quality game, better AI, new maps, new events, better optimisation in the next update. 

There are a lot of shortcomings that I am aware of, I would be happy if you can tell me your wishes to be added or corrected via social media or Steam community.

1. 17 new cars added to the game
2. Map expanded
3. 17 new race events added
4. Career mode added
5. Ps4, Ps5, Xbox Controller Added
6. Steering system added
7. UI and menus redesigned
8. Catchup function has been activated.
9. Added water effect
10. Created visual effects for cars vfx
11. Car physics have been improved, engine values are now more realistic.
12. Cars now handle differently on different surfaces such as dirt and asphalt
13. Smoke and tyre tracks added
14. Added FRS3 for optimisation
15. Fixed problems with the weather system. Fixed bugs in sky lighting.
16. Added dynamic time option
17. New weather conditions added
18. Many objects can now be smashed
19. Fixed car engine sounds
20. Details such as grass can now be adjusted in intensity and distance in the graphics settings
21. Optimisation operations were performed
22. Circuit and Timetrial races added
23. Fixed problem with resolution setting
24. Corrections have been made to the car driving support systems. Added new driving assistance systems
25. Automatic, manual gear option added
26. Added cars artificial rotation and brake support system to make the game easier

notes.title: Update V 1.0.0
notes.content:
Update V 1.0.0

First of all, I apologize to everyone for the delayed update, I was able to bring the first update with full time for 4 months. Disadvantages of being a solo developer. The first update was unfortunately just a technical update. The next update will include more tracks and cars.

1. Cars and environment now have real-time reflection system
2. Artificial intelligence has been strengthened, challenger mode has been added
3. All maps have been rebuilt from scratch. This is due to lower ram usage and denser vegetation. It was a mandatory update to create large maps and have more objects.
4. The vegetation has been changed and made better quality
5. Trees can now appear for longer distances
6. Many Technical Bugs fixed
7. Adjusted the car physics, strengthened the vehicles for braking and turns
8. Fixed bugs in car models
9. Added sunflare for sun
10. The car driving assistance system can now be changeable during the race
